answer.held_back_by: I think it was the secret ceiling, the CEP, plus me always picking the honest option. The system probably only lets you rise so far however clean you are. I also never learned how the game really works, so I stayed quiet and plain when I should have played it a bit.
answer.ending_fair_why: Retiring honourably with integrity 100 matched how I played. A bit flat after 40-odd years, but I can't say it was unfair.
answer.chase_next: I'd go for PM, or at least the succession fight, since I put myself forward in Y45 and then it just ended on retirement. I want to see that actually play out, maybe by being less straight and more political.
answer.play_again_why: Too many years in a row felt the same, and I'd want a break first. I might come back if a friend says a different path is quite different.
